meta.name: writing-great-skills
meta.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 学习编写优质技能的词汇与原则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想写出更清晰、可预测的技能描述。
copy.tagline_en: Learn the vocabulary and principles for writing great skills.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to write clearer and more predictable skill descriptions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会参考一份技能编写指南，包含调用机制、描述编写、信息层级、修剪等原则。当用户要求编写或编辑技能时，Claude 据此提供规范性建议。
howto.when: 当用户说“帮我写一个技能”或“检查这个技能”，或主动输入 “writing-great-skills” 时触发。

say.text: 请根据指南帮我写一个模型调用的技能
say.note: Claude 会参考 invocation 部分编写描述。

say.text: 这个技能描述里有没有重复的触发词？
say.note: Claude 会运用 duplication 原则进行审查。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude gains a reference guide for writing and editing skills, covering invocation, description writing, information hierarchy, pruning, etc. It uses this guide to provide normative advice when asked to create or edit a skill.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'write a skill', 'edit this skill', or explicitly invokes 'writing-great-skills'.

say_en.text: Write a model-invoked skill following the guide.
say_en.note: Claude will reference the invocation section.

say_en.text: Check this skill description for duplication.
